title: PostgreSQL: a primary key with a text column is refused under DEFAULT replica identity

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: PostgreSQL 16.15 and 17.11, gateway runtime 18.3

symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_CDC_NOT_ENABLED: does not have primary key or has a TOAST-able type column, and needs FULL REPLICA IDENTITY. The same message says to use DEFAULT when there is a primary key.
cause: Not isolated. The reason stayed on one table after a drop and recreate.
effect: The table isn't captured; the update fails at analysis and no snapshot runs.
fix: ALTER TABLE ... REPLICA IDENTITY FULL. If the same message stays, create a new gateway and ingestion pipeline pair with the same settings.
notes: FULL cleared it on one pair; on two others it stayed until a new pair was created.
